title: Dorian Finney-Smith Reacts To Adult Content Company Responding To His 2022 Exit Interview Comments
htmlContent:
Earlier this year, Dallas Mavericks forward Dorian Finney Smith dubbed himself along with Reggie Bullock 'The Bang Bros' during their exit interviews. After their loss to the Golden State Warriors in the Western Conference Finals in five games.

“I thought it was going to move a little faster, you know, Bang Bros… The Bang Bros,” Said Smith.

Bally Sports’ Brandon ‘Scoop B’ Robinson then proceed to tweet, “Collaboration with BangBros.com in the near future for Dorian Finney Smith and Reggie Bullock apparently.”

The porn company saw Robinson’s tweet and replied, “Sounds like plan 100 percent.”

Monday afternoon during Mavs media day, Smith reacted to the response from the adult content company.

With a shocked look, he asked if Reggie Bullock had seen the response. At the time of the writing of this piece, Bullock has not seen the answer from the adult content company.

Last season for the Dallas Mavericks, Dorian Finney Smith averaged 11.0 points, 4.7 rebounds, 1.9 assists per game and played 80 games for the Mavs. He also signed a four-year extension worth  $55,560,960, according to Sportstrac.com.

Meanwhile, Reggie Bullock averaged 8.6 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.2 assists per game in 68 games for the Mavericks.

The 2022-23 NBA regular season starts next month.
